title: Depth bound for unfolding a DAG
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean DAG circuit whose gates have distinct arguments and whose NOT gates each have exactly one argument. The depth of the tree obtained by unfolding $C$ is at most the depth of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
